name: Malcolm Wellmaker
event: UFC Fight Night: Allen vs. Duncan
summary: A bantamweight knockout puncher (three straight first-round KOs to start his UFC run), now on two straight losses and newly at American Top Team.

how_they_fight.Grappling: Takedown defense about 50%; submitted by Juan Diaz in May.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Lost a decision to Ethyn Ewing when the fight went long.

news.text: Switched camps to American Top Team after two losses.
